# Uncle Cat AI Radar

> Uncle Cat AI Radar（中文名：猫叔的AI资讯雷达）is an autonomous, source-linked AI news radar by Uncle Cat. It publishes bilingual AI briefings and quick-hit radar updates on models, research, products, policy, open source, safety, funding, and industry, with original source links and timestamps.

Canonical site: https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/
Publisher: Uncle Cat (https://x.com/mmlong8)
Former names: AI Focus Bulletin, AI专注速报
Languages: English and zh-CN
Update cadence: twice daily around 07:00 and 19:00 Beijing time
Access policy: public, free, no ads, no trackers, no paywall

## Latest briefings

- [Anthropic Opens Claude Duet as a Proactive AI Agent](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/anthropic-claude-duet-agent.html): Anthropic is testing Claude Duet, an agent that monitors priorities, completes tasks and asks for approval before sensitive actions.
- [IBM Releases Open Granite Time-Series Ensemble Recipe](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/ibm-granite-forecasting-ensemble.html): IBM Research publishes an open forecasting recipe that combines four Granite time-series models for zero-shot and probabilistic prediction.
- [OpenAI Brings Frontier Models and Codex to Google Cloud](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/openai-models-google-cloud.html): OpenAI will offer its frontier models and Codex workflows through Google Cloud, giving enterprises access to another major cloud route.
- [Recursive Releases Flint, a 40B Open Coding Model](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/recursive-flint-local-coding-model.html): Recursive has released Flint under Apache 2.0, pairing a sparse 40B architecture with local deployment for coding agents.
- [Tencent’s WorkForge Scales Verifiable Training for Work Agents](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/tencent-workforge-agent-training.html): Tencent researchers introduce WorkForge, a framework that turns real-world files and workflows into verifiable environments for long-horizon agents.
- [Anthropic Tests Claude on Scorpion-Toxin Protein Design](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/anthropic-scorpion-binder-design.html): Claude generated and screened hundreds of thousands of protein designs, with 17 of 211 tested candidates binding scorpion neurotoxins in the lab.
- [Mistral Launches Voxtral 3 Voice-Agent Model Family](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/mistral-voxtral-3-voice-agents.html): Mistral’s Voxtral 3 combines multilingual speech models with a LiveKit-based agent SDK for systems that listen, reason, call tools, and speak.
- [NVIDIA Releases Kumo Forecast for Explainable Time-Series AI](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/nvidia-kumo-forecast.html): NVIDIA’s Kumo Forecast combines pretrained time-series representations, historical-pattern retrieval and interpretability for forecasting workloads.
- [OpenAI Acquires Orchestra Bio to Build Drug-Development Agents](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/openai-orchestra-bio-acquisition.html): OpenAI is combining Orchestra Bio with Rosalind to automate the coordination layer of drug development, extending AI from discovery into execution.
- [AWS targets Nvidia lock-in with new PyTorch Trainium tool](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/aws-torchneuron-trainium.html): AWS introduced TorchNeuron to let PyTorch developers move workloads to Trainium with minimal code changes, challenging Nvidia’s software advantage.
- [DeepSeek Open-Sources the Inference Stack Behind V4.1 Flash](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/deepseek-opens-deepinfer-inference-stack.html): DeepSeek released DeepInfer and deepseek-recipe, opening the serving software behind its latest model and lowering barriers to large-scale deployment.
- [OpenCode Console breach exposes AI API keys and costs](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/opencode-console-breach.html): A breach affecting 1.4% of OpenCode Console users triggered unauthorized AI charges and exposed a difficult gap in defensive model access.
- [Tenstorrent raises $1.5 billion for open-model chips](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/tenstorrent-open-weight-chips.html): Tenstorrent reached a $6.2 billion valuation after raising $1.5 billion to scale inference hardware for open-weight models and video generation.
- [US Orders DeepSeek Removed From Federal Civilian Systems](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/us-orders-deepseek-removal-federal-systems.html): A DHS order bars civilian agencies from buying DeepSeek technology and requires removal of third-party products built on its implementations.
- [Anthropic Commits 5% of Shares to Public Benefit Fund](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/anthropic-public-benefit-fund.html): Anthropic will place 5% of its equity in a wholly owned fund, tying future public-benefit spending to the company’s growth and governance.

## Latest Chinese briefings

- [Anthropic开放Claude Duet主动式代理研究预览](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/anthropic-claude-duet-agent.html): Anthropic开始测试Claude Duet，让代理主动发现待办、执行任务，并在敏感操作前请求用户批准。
- [IBM开源Granite时序模型集成预测方案](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/ibm-granite-forecasting-ensemble.html): IBM研究院发布Granite Timeseries Ensemble R1，将四款时序模型组合到统一接口中，支持零样本和概率预测。
- [OpenAI前沿模型与Codex将登陆Google Cloud](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/openai-models-google-cloud.html): OpenAI将通过Google Cloud提供前沿模型和Codex代理工作流，企业可在现有云治理体系内采购和部署。
- [Recursive发布Flint：面向编码代理的40B开放模型](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/recursive-flint-local-coding-model.html): Recursive以Apache 2.0许可发布Flint，采用稀疏40B架构，主打可在自有硬件上运行的编码代理。
- [腾讯WorkForge扩展可验证工作智能体训练环境](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/tencent-workforge-agent-training.html): 腾讯与复旦研究者推出WorkForge，把真实文件和专业流程转化为可验证的长程智能体训练环境。
- [Anthropic让Claude设计蝎毒蛋白结合剂并完成实验验证](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/anthropic-scorpion-binder-design.html): Claude生成超过31万种蛋白设计，实验测试的211个候选物中有17个能结合蝎毒神经毒素。
- [Mistral发布Voxtral 3，主打实时语音智能体](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/mistral-voxtral-3-voice-agents.html): Mistral推出Voxtral 3语音模型家族和LiveKit智能体SDK，让系统实时听取、推理、调用工具并开口回应。
- [英伟达发布可解释时间序列预测系统 Kumo Forecast](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/nvidia-kumo-forecast.html): 英伟达推出 Kumo Forecast，将预训练时间序列表征、历史模式检索与可解释性结合，用于更贴近业务场景的预测任务。
- [OpenAI收购Orchestra Bio，进军药物研发智能体](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/openai-orchestra-bio-acquisition.html): OpenAI将Orchestra Bio并入生命科学项目Rosalind，目标是让AI从辅助发现扩展到药物研发的全流程协调。
- [AWS推出TorchNeuron，正面挑战英伟达软件壁垒](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/aws-torchneuron-trainium.html): AWS发布TorchNeuron，试图让PyTorch开发者以极少代码改动迁移到Trainium，切入英伟达最牢固的软件优势。
- [深度求索开源支撑 V4.1 Flash 的推理栈](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/deepseek-opens-deepinfer-inference-stack.html): 深度求索开源 DeepInfer 推理框架及 deepseek-recipe，首次把最新模型背后的部分生产级服务技术交给社区。
- [OpenCode控制台遭入侵，用户AI账户被刷费](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/opencode-console-breach.html): 一次影响1.4%控制台用户的入侵导致API密钥暴露和异常账单，也暴露了防御团队调用模型时的现实障碍。
- [Tenstorrent融资15亿美元，押注开放模型推理芯片](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/tenstorrent-open-weight-chips.html): AI芯片公司Tenstorrent融资15亿美元、估值升至62亿美元，将扩大面向开放权重模型和视频生成的推理硬件。
- [美国要求联邦民用机构移除深度求索技术](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/us-orders-deepseek-removal-federal-systems.html): 美国国土安全部要求联邦民用机构移除深度求索及其衍生产品，并禁止采购相关技术。
- [Anthropic承诺拿出5%股份设立公共利益基金](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/anthropic-public-benefit-fund.html): Anthropic将把5%的公司股份投入全资公共利益基金，并让基金规模随公司估值增长而扩大。

## Source and citation policy

- Every article has a stable canonical URL, a Chinese alternate URL, visible source links, JSON-LD NewsArticle metadata, and machine-readable citation URLs.
- Use the original source links on each article for factual verification.
- Treat this site as an original synthesis and monitoring layer, not as the primary source when a linked company, paper, filing, or official post is available.
- If referencing a quick hit from X or another social source, preserve its timestamp and original URL.
